Legal Profession Act
(Chapter 161)
Approved Finance Companies (Consolidation) Notification
N 4
REVISED EDITION 2010
(31st May 2010)
The Minister for Law, for the purposes of the Rules specified in Part I of the Schedule, has approved the finance companies specified in Part II of the Schedule for the deposit of client’s money received by an advocate and solicitor.

THE SCHEDULE
Part I
Rules
1. The Legal Profession (Deposit Interest) Rules (R 5).
2. The Legal Profession (Solicitors’ Accounts) Rules (R 8).
3. The Legal Profession (Solicitors’ Trust Accounts) Rules (R 9).
4. The Legal Profession (Accountant’s Report) Rules (R 10).
Part II
Finance Companies
1. Hong Leong Finance Limited.
[S 447/99 —12.10.99]
2. Singapura Finance Limited1.
1 Singapura Building Society Limited was renamed Singapura Finance Limited with effect from 12th June 2002.
[S 447/99 - 12.10.99]
3. Sing Investments & Finance Limited.
[2683/2001 - 27.9.2001]
